mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the time when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals an economic slowdown that prompts the Federal Reserve to initiate monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the time when UNRATE is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the time when CPIAUCSL is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the time when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates an economic contraction, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the time when INDPRO is below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market slowdown regime (HOUST < 1200.0), weak residential construction activity reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the time when HOUST is below 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the time when HOUST is above 1300.0.
